breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained conflicting instructions, specifying both 'Explicit forward Euler' and a detailed 'Strang splitting' method for time integration. The ground truth resolved this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' line. The agent correctly identified the detailed Strang splitting instructions as the intended method and completely omitted any mention of the conflicting Euler method, thereby resolving the inconsistency.
